typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Oswald (display sans), tracking-tight, uppercase styling. DO NOT use Inter or generic defaults.
typography.body: Manrope or existing body font. Clean and highly readable at small sizes.
typography.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl to text-6xl, H2: text-3xl to text-4xl, H3: text-xl to text-2xl. Adhere to a strict hierarchy gap.

colors.background: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) to Pure Black (#000000). Never pure flat black without texture.
colors.primary: Neon Cyan (#00FFE0) - Mercedes AMG Petronas vibe.
colors.secondary: Neon Purple (#B026FF) - Lewis Hamilton signature helmet vibe.
colors.accent: Electric Blaze Red (#FF3B30) for high-impact micro-interactions.

layouts.hero: Preserve the existing full-screen Hero exactly as it is. Do not modify its structure or aesthetic.
layouts.circuit_hub: A top-down immersive track map that appears *only after* scrolling past the Hero. The SVG track should scale to fill the viewport bounds dynamically. Uses an absolute or fixed layout within a massive scroll container.
layouts.full_screen_chapter: When a chapter marker is clicked, the camera pans to the marker, and a glassmorphic/dark panel expands to full screen to show the chapter. Normal scroll within the chapter. Must include a sticky 'Back to Circuit' button.

motion.scroll_camera_pan: Use Framer Motion `useScroll` tied to a tall scroll container (e.g., 500vh). Map the `scrollYProgress` to the total length of the SVG path. Use `SVGPathElement.getPointAtLength()` to calculate the exact X/Y. Translate the SVG container negatively to keep the glowing dot centered (acting as a dynamic racing-camera).
motion.path_drawing: Use `motion.path` with `pathLength` mapped to scroll progress. Draw a glowing cyan racing line over a faint white/10 base stroke.
motion.marker_click: Trigger a Lenis `scrollTo` to the exact scroll offset of the marker's path percentage, followed by an expansion animation for the chapter UI.
motion.reduced_motion: Provide a standard sequential vertical scroll fallback for users with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

visual_enhancers.glowing_markers: Interactive circuit markers should have a pulsing drop-shadow: `drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,224,0.8)]`.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use high-end glass for the 'Back to Circuit' control and chapter overlay panels. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10`.
visual_enhancers.grain_texture: Apply a subtle noise/grain SVG overlay across the entire app with pointer-events-none to give an editorial, high-end film feel.

media.instruction: Manually recreate the Silverstone SVG path (a single continuous `<path>`) matching the shape from the reference image, omitting all buildings and arrows. The path should be clean, scalable, and unbroken to ensure `getPointAtLength()` works flawlessly.

component_instructions.CircuitExperience: Wrapper component handling Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion logic. Tall height (e.g., 800vh) to allow long scrolling.
component_instructions.SilverstoneMap: SVG component containing the base track path, the glowing progress path (`pathLength`), and the chapter markers positioned explicitly along the path's length.
component_instructions.ChapterMarker: A glowing dot with a title label. Uses `data-testid='chapter-marker-{id}'`.
component_instructions.BackToCircuitButton: Sticky pill button. Glassmorphic. Left-aligned or centered at top. `data-testid='back-to-circuit-btn'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT alter the existing Hero component. The new logic must strictly happen *after* the Hero scroll.
Recreate the Silverstone track as an SVG `<path>` matching the provided reference image shape.
Calculate marker positions dynamically using `getPointAtLength(totalLength * percentage)` or hardcode exact x/y coordinates that perfectly intersect the SVG track.
Implement a dynamic racing camera: as the user scrolls, translate the SVG wrapper using `useTransform` so that the current path position remains in the center of the viewport.
Ensure 'Back to Circuit' button smooth-scrolls or collapses the full-screen view back to the map hub.
Ensure all markers are clickable. Clicking one uses Lenis to scroll to that segment, then expands.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='chapter-marker-1'`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and layered glassmorphism.
Never apply `transition: all` as it breaks Framer Motion transforms.
Do not center align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include hover states and micro-interactions on all clickable elements.
